high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "uncoverscience." The post features a black-and-white photograph of a glass container suspended by strings, with liquid helium inside it. The liquid appears to be flowing over the rim of the container, which is a phenomenon known as superfluidity. The text overlay on the image reads: "Helium at -273°C" and provides additional information about the properties of helium when cooled to almost absolute zero Kelvin (-460°F or -273°C).
